- **G? [M] Explore: each town's fixtures as a data set, read by the app** (2026-11-21) · Earn · no surface
  Area: explore, discovery. From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-21). Brief: docs/research/municipal-fixtures.md.
  Calls: an OpenStreetMap-first third pack in chronicles-data, Overture and Wikidata folded in at build; a visitor centre is the town's tourist office, an attraction's stays a find; the data set first, the card line and layer after with a mock-up; the list from Monday's count. Decision 0255 (amends 0225).
  Done when: the app, in a test on the web build, reads Stowe's and Marfa's fixtures from the pack through its adapter and finds each town's tourist office where OpenStreetMap has one, its town hall and its library, and nothing of a kind outside the list.
  Touches: decision 0225 (words only, never counted, never a find), 0255, 0005 (nothing leaves the device beyond the pack's reads), 0156 (no dataset hard-coded); specs/town-fixtures TF1, TF2, TF4, TF5, TF14, TF19, TF21 (on claude/determined-wright-yg1fq9).
  The slice: 1. A fixtures pack is built in chronicles-data beside places and stores, OpenStreetMap first, Overture and Wikidata (or the public-library survey) folded in where strong, one fixture kept once. 2. Its kinds are a closed list in the pack's contract, drawn from the OpenStreetMap kind counts and approved by the owner; a visitor centre is a town's tourist office (information=office), never an attraction's. 3. Practical amenities (toilets, parking, drinking water) are not in it. 4. A fixture carries its kind, its position and its name where it has one, and nothing a crowd says. 5. The app reads it through an adapter with an in-memory source for tests; nothing is hard-coded, and a region with no pack yields none. 6. It is read by tile, only for what is on screen, with bounded reads that can be stopped. 7. Nothing leaves the device beyond the pack's byte-range reads from the host the other packs come from. 8. Nothing stored counts fixtures.
  Precedent: Michelin town plans mark tourist information and post offices beside the sights; OpenStreetMap separates a town's tourist office from an attraction's visitor centre; Apple Maps draws civic glyphs with no switch (docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "Mark a town's staples"; all unverified). Mock-up: none, no surface; the screens' step draws one (decision 0252).
  Payoff: the ground every later fixture screen stands on; known ahead for any town, been to or not. Cost: M; a data-repo slice (an extractor, a merge, a contract) and a small one here (the pin, an adapter); no native code. Reopens: explore, discovery. After it: the card's line and the map's layer (TF6-TF13), mock-up first.
  Instead: Overture read live with no pack (the brief's option B), patchy for tourist offices as measured.
  Open: the list of kinds (TF1), from Monday's osmKindCounts (chronicles-data's scheduled build, Nov 23), brought to the owner before the contract is fixed.
